title: Air icon
section: Second round: stage machinery, footlights and the HUD
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
A single round silvery air bubble with a highlight, as rising from the grotto vents. Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 40:40. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Match the established Méliès hand-painted toy-theatre look.
No text or watermark.
